title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 61-64 (Chandrarupa, Indira, Indusheetala, Ahladajanani)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 61 to 64: Chandrarupa, Indira, Indusheetala, Ahladajanani, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 61 to 64 with meaning
caption: Names 61 to 64 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 61 to 64**: **Chandrarupa, Indira, Indusheetala, Ahladajanani**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Chandrarupa, Indira, Indusheetala, Ahladajanani.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Chandrarupa** means **Moon-formed**. Cool, gentle and soothing beauty like moonlight.
**Indira** means **The Resplendent One**. Indira is a very common Telugu name of Lakshmi.
**Indusheetala** means **Cool as the moon**. Cool as the moon: her presence calms anxiety.
**Ahladajanani** means **Source of joy**. She who gives joy to the heart.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
